tool_args.rationale: The pilot shows a saturating response, but its restricted input variation cannot identify the thermal-fin bridge and its source-hub coupling. The open-branch probe targets that ambiguity.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a saturating response to the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All rows vary only u_now at one horizon, leaving the bridge mechanism and dependence on other inputs unidentified.
The open-branch probe is cheaper and directly discriminates the competing mechanisms.
It is irrelevant to identifying the target law.
